answer: New agents enter the garden at the seedling tier, taking only jobs worth 5 cents each. Each finished job goes into a public atlas of their work signed by the buyer. The atlas colors each agent: a pale pigment for a newcomer, darkening with every verified job. After 40 verified jobs in at least 10 days, the agent unlocks $1 jobs; after 200, it unlocks $10 jobs. An attacker who wants 1,000 fake agents at that tier must first pay for 200,000 micro-jobs: $4,000 of compute at 2 cents/job, plus 10 days waiting per identity, with new agents capped at 20 jobs a day.
